def longest(take a: list[int], take b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Consume both lists and return the longer one; a wins a tie."""
    ex longest([1, 2, 3], [4]) == [1, 2, 3]
    ex longest([1], [4, 5]) == [4, 5]
    ex longest([1, 2], [3, 4]) == [1, 2]
    ex longest([], []) == []
    if b.len() > a.len():
        return b
    return a
